mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(link.canonical_entity_id, achievement.id) FROM achievement LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link link ON link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND link.entity_id = achievement.id WHERE achievement.id = #{achievementId}

SELECT a.id AS achievement_id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), a.title_normalized, a.title_original) AS title, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(type_override.field_value), a.achievement_type) AS achievement_type, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(language_override.field_value), a.language) AS language, COALESCE(STR_TO_DATE(JSON_UNQUOTE(date_override.field_value), '%Y-%m-%d'), a.publication_date) AS publication_date, a.doi_normalized AS doi, COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(venue_override.field_value) AS UNSIGNED), venue_link.canonical_entity_id, a.primary_venue_id) AS venue_id, venue.display_name AS venue_name, venue.venue_type AS venue_type, venue.issn_l AS venue_issn FROM achievement a LEFT JOIN manual_field_override title_override ON title_override.achievement_id = a.id AND title_override.field_name = 'title' AND title_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override type_override ON type_override.achievement_id = a.id AND type_override.field_name = 'type' AND type_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override language_override ON language_override.achievement_id = a.id AND language_override.field_name = 'language' AND language_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override date_override ON date_override.achievement_id = a.id AND date_override.field_name = 'publicationDate' AND date_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN manual_field_override venue_override ON venue_override.achievement_id = a.id AND venue_override.field_name = 'venueId' AND venue_override.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link venue_link ON venue_link.entity_type = 'VENUE' AND venue_link.entity_id = a.primary_venue_id LEFT JOIN venue ON venue.id = COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(venue_override.field_value) AS UNSIGNED), venue_link.canonical_entity_id, a.primary_venue_id) WHERE a.id = #{achievementId}

SELECT resolved.id, resolved.display_name AS name, resolved.orcid FROM ( SELECT COALESCE(link.canonical_entity_id, author.id) AS id, COALESCE(canonical.display_name, author.display_name) AS display_name, orcid.external_id AS orcid, MIN(aa.author_position) AS author_position FROM achievement_author aa JOIN author ON author.id = aa.author_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link link ON link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND link.entity_id = author.id LEFT JOIN author canonical ON canonical.id = link.canonical_entity_id LEFT JOIN author_external_id orcid ON orcid.author_id = COALESCE(link.canonical_entity_id, author.id) AND orcid.id_type = 'ORCID' WHERE aa.achievement_id = #{achievementId} GROUP BY COALESCE(link.canonical_entity_id, author.id), COALESCE(canonical.display_name, author.display_name), orcid.external_id ) resolved ORDER BY resolved.author_position, resolved.id

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(author_link.canonical_entity_id, rel.author_id) AS author_id, COALESCE(org_link.canonical_entity_id, rel.organization_id) AS institution_id, COALESCE(canonical_org.display_name, organization.display_name) AS institution_name, ror.external_id AS standard_code, COALESCE(canonical_org.country_code, organization.country_code) AS country_code FROM authorship_organization rel JOIN organization ON organization.id = rel.organization_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link author_link ON author_link.entity_type = 'AUTHOR' AND author_link.entity_id = rel.author_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link org_link ON org_link.entity_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND org_link.entity_id = rel.organization_id LEFT JOIN organization canonical_org ON canonical_org.id = org_link.canonical_entity_id LEFT JOIN organization_external_id ror ON ror.organization_id = COALESCE(org_link.canonical_entity_id, rel.organization_id) AND ror.id_type = 'ROR' WHERE rel.achievement_id = #{achievementId}

SELECT subject.id, subject.display_name AS name, subject.external_id AS code, subject.subject_path AS path FROM achievement_subject rel JOIN subject ON subject.id = rel.subject_id WHERE rel.achievement_id = #{achievementId} ORDER BY rel.subject_position, subject.id

SELECT DISTINCT canonical.id, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(title_override.field_value), canonical.title_normalized, canonical.title_original) AS title, canonical.achievement_type, canonical.language, canonical.publication_date, canonical.doi_normalized AS doi FROM achievement_reference rel JOIN achievement cited ON cited.id = rel.cited_achievement_id LEFT JOIN canonical_entity_link link ON link.entity_type = 'ACHIEVEMENT' AND link.entity_id = cited.id JOIN achievement canonical ON canonical.id = COALESCE(link.canonical_entity_id, cited.id) LEFT JOIN manual_field_override title_override ON title_override.achievement_id = canonical.id AND title_override.field_name = 'title' AND title_override.active = TRUE WHERE rel.citing_achievement_id = #{achievementId}
